name: People map
job: Everyone you deal with, and where you stand
intro: People map builds itself from your mail and meetings: who each person is, their company, how warm things are, what is owed both ways, and when you next meet.
does: Tells the people you deal with apart from receipts, lists and cold pitches.
Counts how warm each contact is from how often you usually talk, and flags who has gone quiet.
Writes where things stand with anyone, each line pointing to where it came from.
setup: Set up Mail or Meetings first: People map reads what they read.
Choose which of your mail categories are people you deal with.
Confirm your company's own domains, so colleagues are not counted as contacts.
Review who it found: add, remove or settle anyone.
